IC1: Informed consent as documented by signature (see informed consent form)
IC2: Primary ITP [AND] according to the definition of Rodeghiero et al. (52) and a platelet count of <30x109/l
IC4: Previously treated patients, with failure or intolerance to first-line therapy [OR], or relapse after first-line therapy, i.e. corticosteroids [OR], intravenous immunoglobulin [OR] (IVIG), or anti-D immunoglobulins
